daily_norms.caption: Daily Norms & Social Etiquette
rows: Small bow or nod; arigatou gozaimasu
Walk on tatami with outdoor shoes
Leave coins — staff may chase you
Flash in dark halls; drone without permit

phrases.caption: Essential Japanese Phrases
rows: ありがとうございます
英語メニューありますか？

train.caption: Train & Shinkansen Etiquette
rows: Avoid unless marked open; yield to elderly
Front pack or between feet in rush hour
OK on Shinkansen; avoid strong smells on commuter metro
Sit in unreserved or reserved seat on ticket — not Green unless paid
Last trains ~midnight Tokyo; plan taxi or stay near Dotonbori

temple.caption: Temple & Shrine Etiquette
rows: Rinse left hand, right hand, mouth at chozuya
2 bows, 2 claps, 1 bow at main hall
Incense, single bow; no clap at some
Coin in box; no required amount
Quiet paths; step aside for ceremonies

items.label: Chopsticks
items.detail: Don't stick upright in rice; don't pass food chopstick-to-chopstick

items.label: Soy sauce
items.detail: Don't pour over rice bowl at kaiseki

items.label: Izakaya
items.detail: Order drink first; shared plates normal even solo

items.label: Sushi counter
items.detail: Ask chef omakase or point; eat piece within moment

items.label: Kushikatsu
items.detail: No double-dipping sauce (one bite per dip rule)

items.label: Konbini
items.detail: Eat at store counter or park bench — not walking

items.label: Onsen order
items.detail: Wash body completely before entering tub

items.label: Tattoos
items.detail: Some public baths restrict — ryokan private bath often OK

items.label: Towel
items.detail: Never in tub water; fold on head or edge

items.label: Dinner
items.detail: Arrive on time for kaiseki seatings

bullets.heading: Regional Notes
items: Tokyo: Stand left on escalators; few trash bins — carry out.
Kyoto: Softer voice in Gion; no blocking geiko for photos.
Osaka: Casual food culture — still no litter.
